"""Contact orphan detection for the nightly integrity check."""


def find_orphans(contacts: list[dict], accounts: list[dict]) -> list[str]:
    """Return live contact IDs whose account has no live matching account row."""
    live_account_ids = {
        account.get("ACCT_ID", "")
        for account in accounts
        if account.get("DEL_FLG", "") != "Y"
        and account.get("ACCT_ID", "") != ""
    }

    orphan_ids = [
        contact.get("CONT_ID", "")
        for contact in contacts
        if contact.get("DEL_FLG", "") != "Y"
        and contact.get("ACCT_ID", "") not in live_account_ids
    ]

    return sorted(orphan_ids)
